🚨 Here were my favorite announcements from Supabase (which have implications for anyone moving from prototype to production): ↱ Supabase has acquired Turso for $150M: Say you want your agent to try 10 different ways to build a feature. Each version might need its own database. Turso is designed for databases that start quickly, are cheap to run, and scale to zero when unused.  ↱OrioleDB makes a single database fast while reducing the amount of hands-on work it requires. ↱Multigres: tackles reliability as your app grows.
